notes.title: Silent Research is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

After a lot of work, Silent Research is finally out on Steam. This is my first game, and I really hope you enjoy it.

It’s a short, atmospheric horror experience set in a foggy forest, where you have to find lost GPS trackers and piece together what’s happening—while something watches from the shadows.

I tried to focus on building tension and atmosphere rather than relying on jumpscares. If you check it out, I’d love to hear your thoughts—whether it’s feedback, theories, or just your experience playing.

I really hope you enjoy the game.

notes.title: Silent Research – A Short, Atmospheric Horror Game (Coming Soon! Wishlist Now!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’m the solo dev behind Silent Research, an atmospheric horror experience inspired by games like Iron Lung and Squirrel Stapler. The game is coming to Steam on February 28th, and I’d love to hear your thoughts!

What is Silent Research?
You are Andrew, a researcher trapped in a foggy, haunted forest.
You must recover your lost research devices and escape—before it is too late.
The more you uncover, the more terrifying the truth becomes…

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499770/Silent_Research/

🎥 Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dpKDYUEBEN4&ab_channel=Eduard-MihaiRusu

What do you think? Would you play this? Let me know what makes a horror game truly terrifying for you!
